scope: 14 candidate primary-source references for remote-sensing scene classification, transfer learning, scale, transformers and domain pretraining; not a systematic review or performance ranking
full_text_access_note: Web search sometimes returned substantial indexed publisher text while direct open returned HTTP 429/403. Such records are labelled publisher_index_text; they are not represented as successful full-text opens. No third-party summaries supply the accepted bibliographic fields or mechanism claims.
bibliographic_conventions: Every candidate includes the complete displayed author list; initials are retained when the primary source itself displays initials.
Article identifiers in MDPI entries occupy the pages field for compatibility with the existing bibliography style; they are not page counts.
Unverified DOI/page fields are omitted, not inferred from secondary indexes.
SatMAE++ final CVF metadata spells its fourth author Rao Muhammad Anwer; arXiv and PDF spell Anwar. Final CVF BibTeX is used and the discrepancy is retained below.
Scale-MAE uses final CVF record pages 4088--4099; alternate indexing pagination was not imported.
general_boundaries: Literature results are not measurements under the GAViT project's frozen protocol.
Multi-spectral, temporal, text-supervised, zero-shot and large pretraining settings must not be directly ranked against the project's RGB supervised runs.
Scene-classification references were selected on explicit scene/land-cover classification relevance; segmentation or detection transfer is described only as an additional task where applicable.
HGTNet bibliographic identity is verified from a coauthor's official homepage; detailed architecture must use an independently accessed original paper, not infer it from the title.

entries.mechanism: Evaluates fixed ConvNet descriptors trained on everyday objects on aerial scenes and remote-sensing imagery, including descriptor fusion.
entries.boundary: Transfer was not uniformly superior in both studied domains; this does not establish a universal advantage of natural-image features or the project's fine-tuned protocol.

entries.role: CNN feature transfer and multi-scale aggregation
entries.mechanism: Compares fully connected activations with multi-scale dense convolutional features encoded by conventional feature coding and classified by a linear SVM.
entries.boundary: The backbone is used as a fixed pretrained extractor; orderless aggregation and multiple image scales are distinct from learned spatial regions or a region graph.

entries.role: resolution/scale handling in CNN scene classification
entries.mechanism: Converts fully connected layers to convolutional layers and uses global average pooling to accommodate variable-size images within a pretrained CNN-based classifier.
entries.boundary: Scale-free input handling is not equivalent to scale invariance or learned semantic region grouping; the approach does not supply evidence about a GAT branch.

entries.mechanism: TRS transitions from convolutional stages through an MHSA bottleneck to transformer encoders, replacing spatial convolutions with self-attention in the transition blocks.
entries.boundary: A local/global hybrid is already present in prior scene-classification work; it is not the same architecture or ablation as adding a small regional GAT after the last Swin stage.
